verdict.rationale: Lorikeet's first-party docs cover the full story. Simulations can be generated from actual historical tickets and run in bulk batches, and historical tickets and synthetic scenarios can be replayed to project resolution quality before deployment. Side-by-side batch comparisons with per-conversation drill-downs and adversarial guardrail scenarios are also documented, and simulations can be run via MCP and skills. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the simulation and replay features work as claimed.
